name: Terrarium 75x35x45x35
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 75x35x45 cm. Volume: 118 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This model measures 75 cm in length, 35 cm in width and 45 cm in height, with about 118 liters. The floor has 2625 cm². The 45 cm height is greater than the width, so plenty of air is left above the animal for a lamp and decor. The ventilation is mesh, with no 3D background.

Over 75 cm of length a young ball python has a warm and a cool hide half a meter apart. For young tortoises and a skink the floor is enough in the first period, with the caveat that 35 cm of width is too little for adults. The height allows a cork island or a shelf above the floor. An adult bearded dragon needs a longer and wider floor.

The wider model of the same length is the 75x40x60. If you need a divider, a shelf or a different layout inside, describe it to us when ordering. A build to measure takes 7 to 14 days. We cover the outer sides with film, and you choose the pattern from the 34 on offer.
